'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Chris Schoenthal DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' imrhil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals

== Decklist ==

The sheet lists no cards. It names the deck "Rops" and refers to another list instead; as written: "See Kren Shannon's 13 from MPC Day 2" (the last line is hard to read). That list has not been identified, so no cards are given here.
